    Morning briefing

    Morning briefing

    Mandate: Mix (any). OVERNIGHT: Asia's last bars are stale 2026-10-20 sessions and closed down (Nikkei 225 -1.30%, Hang Seng -1.32%, KOSPI -3.73%, Shanghai +0.12%); Europe closed up (DAX +1.35%, Euro Stoxx 50 +1.40%, FTSE 100 +0.19%); the futures rows read up (S&P 500 futures +0.45%, Nasdaq 100 futures +1.09%), so Asia and the futures disagree - the shape that most often retraces. This board sits after the open because the owner asked for this morning's briefing after the bell (R113's reason); at the 12:45:46 ET freeze SPY is +0.51%, QQQ +1.24%, IWM +0.38%, VIX 16.76 (-3.18%), the 10-year 5.11 and the dollar index flat, a regime the desk reads as mixed, with the cycle composite projecting +2.97% over 10 sessions. Expected shape: a morning move that retraces and then reclaims - the move to the freeze (SPY +0.51%) has printed, and I expect any afternoon dip to be bought so that SPY closes at or above its 772.95 freeze mark; a close below it scores this expectation wrong. LEADER: The Black Swan leads the pyramid (equity 112245.33), and its read carries no extra weight (R33). It diverges from the room twice: it abstains on all ten shipped share lines, and on contracts it grades the wings that are cheap against their own sigma high where the room is low - MU 72, CRWD 70, AMD 66, DELL 64 - while it grades BLK, the room's first leg, 45 against the room's 50.5.

    WHERE THE ROOM'S FOR VOTES SIT: in the share column - ten longs with one-medians from 57 to 66 - and on one contract, BLK at 50.5; every other leg ships at a median under 50, the room's own statement that those contracts more often lose their premium than pay. The book is ONE long-tape bet: ten long share lines and seven long calls ride the same tape, and only the CMG, CSCO and ABT puts lean the other way. Inside it, BLK, SCHW and COF are one financials bet, HPE, NOW and CRWD (with AAPL) are one technology-calls bet, and the ACN, AMZN and LMT share lines add to open same-side calls.     WHAT INVALIDATES THE DAY: SPY closing below its 772.95 freeze mark breaks the long-tape call under all ten share lines and seven calls; BLK, SCHW and NFLX closing below their freeze marks falsify the option REVERSAL call; a close below 223.95 on ACN or 198.83 on COF kills the share column's two highest lines. HOUSE RULES, decided before the session and not revisited inside it: (1) STAKES - share lines flat at 1.0 (R81); option legs at 1.0, with AAPL, ABT, HPE, NOW and CRWD at 0.5 under R4-OVERFLOW as the desk writes them, and no chair override anywhere (R129(a)). That is 7.5 option units, 6.5 of them (86.7%) on 2026-10-30: a ONE-DATE BOOK of seven calls and three puts beside ten long share lines - one long-tape bet. No adds on any line that is losing and no re-sizing. The ACN, AMZN and LMT share lines stack on same-side open calls, and the AAPL and SCHW legs sit OPPOSITE open puts under the owner's fill; they are recorded as stacked and opposite, not as hedges, and no further ticket opens on those names. (2) EXITS - each share line exits on its close-basis kill or at its stated horizon, whichever comes first, so TSLA, TXN and LMT close at today's close. Each option leg follows its EXIT line: ratchet at its break-even, kill on the underlying's close, else close on 2026-10-29 for the 10-30 legs and 2026-11-05 for BLK. On nine of the ten legs the house kill sits past the point where the stand-in delta has spent the premium, so the premium is the real stop. BLK, SCHW and COF share one fate, and HPE, NOW, CRWD and AAPL share another: kills on two of one group at the same close are read as that bet failing, not as two bad draws. (3) WINDFALL - when a leg's served mark rises to 2 x its premium at a freeze, half is banked at that mark and the record is written before the next freeze (R148); the other half rides to its own exit. The held AMZN and LITE contracts read NOT FIRED at their served freeze marks and ten held claims read WINDFALL STATE UNWRITTEN, so no sentence of mine names an 'only unexecuted windfall', and tonight's R155(b) writer settles them before the next freeze.
